comment: Per-server required-env declarations, keyed by catalog owner/name (RegistryPlugin::key). Every entry is backed by the server's own docs/README (or, for kanboard, a real degraded run: 'KANBOARD_URL is required but was not set'). Values are NEVER stored here — this file only declares WHAT a server needs; the launcher surfaces the requirement (Library 'needs config' hint) and a future stage wires value entry. secret:true hints the UI to treat the value as a credential (never echo/log). Add rows as servers are verified.
